purpose: D2 detector-independent real-master coverage proposal; no accepted labels, training or detector scoring.
review_method: Visual inspection of native stereo-derived master/source raw-waveform extrema and centred annotation-only spectrograms. All overview blocks and linked detail panels inspected. Source-only energy proposals are prompts, not labels. Full-master evidence is required for every proposed onset and negative core. No listening verdict is claimed.
timing: Explicit manual onset brackets in master seconds; midpoint is only a proposed representative. Brackets describe visual localisation, not statistical confidence. Source mapping is +0.136375s for Midnight only; other offsets zero. Native44.1kHz master and48kHz source clocks remain separate where applicable. No beat grid or detector timing used.
unknown_policy: Uncertain intervals are raw physical ambiguity intervals, not already expanded evaluation exclusions. Preserve them for the existing uncertainty-expansion rule if lead accepts the proposal. Clear onset proposals inside any eventual expanded exclusion remain documented, not silently deleted.
selection_limitations: Earliest source-active selection is transition-heavy and yields only one core kick in three families. Selections are not replaced for label yield. Four source-quiet strata have independently inspected active masters. These existing development families do not establish reserved-song generalisation.
